_comment: Synthetic fixture: deterministic, self-contained, no dependency on David's private brain.

index.title: Editor Undo Stack
index.body: The editor maintains an immutable undo stack. Each keystroke appends a new state snapshot rather than mutating the previous one. Ctrl+Z walks the stack backward.

index.title: Agent Permission Model
index.body: Agents run with an optional allowed_tools and denied_tools list mapped to claude --allowedTools / --disallowedTools flags. The permission_mode field controls baseline trust level.

index.title: Brain Graph Architecture
index.body: The brain graph stores nodes with id, title, type, cluster, importance. Edges connect nodes with a type label. Clusters group related nodes and carry color + center coordinates.

index.title: Tauri IPC Commands
index.body: Tauri exposes Rust functions as IPC commands via #[tauri::command]. The frontend calls them with invoke('command_name', args). All async commands return a Result type.

index.title: Platform Health Check
index.body: health() returns a HealthReport with statuses for brain, git, terminal, model, and agentRunner. Each status is 'ok' | 'down' | 'unknown'. An optional details record carries diagnostic strings.

index.title: Missions Persistence Layer
index.body: Missions are saved via missions.save(projectRoot, data) and loaded with missions.load(projectRoot). Tauri stores at <projectRoot>/.lazy/missions.json; Web uses localStorage key 'lazy:missions'.

index.title: Event Bus
index.body: The event bus (src/lib/bus.ts) provides emit and on functions. Events: nav:navigateSpace, nav:focusBrainNode, agent:launch, agent:runningCount, editor:applyEdit, editor:openFile.

index.title: Test Runner Result Format
index.body: tests.run(repoPath) returns TestRunResult: { ok, tool, total, passed, failed, durationMs, failures: [{name, message, file?, line?}], raw }.

index.title: Brain Backlinks and Neighbors
index.body: brain.backlinks(nodeId) returns an array of node ids that link to the given node. brain.neighbors(nodeId) returns adjacent node ids. These map to Tauri commands brain_fetch_backlinks and brain_fetch_neighbors.

index.title: Immutable State Pattern
index.body: All state updates return new objects via spread. Direct mutation is forbidden. Functions must return a new copy with changes applied rather than modifying the original.
